description: The mid/side device as a device: a widening (off, a Haas delay or a detune, with their delay, cents and blend), a level for the mid, a level for the side and a bass mono frequency, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the source of the detune's worklet (the shifters of @audio/spatial-microshift), with no panel and no audio in it.
name: mid-side-device
